title: ツーリング中 2台のオートバイが接触 53歳男性死亡 東京 青梅

translated_text: On the morning of the 3rd, two motorcycles collided and fell on the Ken-o Expressway in Ome City, Tokyo. Among the two riders, a 53-year-old man died. The man was touring with 13 companions at the time, and the Tokyo Metropolitan Police are investigating the details of the accident.
title_en: Two Motorcycles Collide During Touring, 53-Year-Old Man Dies in Ome, Tokyo
